name: mapping-constructor-expr-test-833706cb84/readonly-field-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString, but not isReadOnly; ballerina/lang.error lists only message.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; the list includes error:message and value:toString/value:toBalString, but neither error:detail nor value:isReadOnly.
Expressions: "Mapping constructor" with "Currently spread-field not supported"; "Trap expression" and "Type test expression" are supported.
reason: The case essentially asserts readonly inference via repeated isReadOnly() calls and validates mutation panics through err.detail()["message"]. Both langlib methods are outside the explicit supported lists, so the whole case requires unsupported features even though mapping constructors, traps and type tests are supported.
unsupported_constructs: ballerina/lang.value:isReadOnly invoked as a method to assert record/map mutability
ballerina/lang.error:detail invoked as a method to assert exact readonly-mutation error details
test_design_notes: io:print("") is instrumentation and does not determine classification.
The assertions check runtime readonly inference, prohibited mutations, preserved values and exact error-detail messages.
